title: Playboy Magazine February 1972 Behind the Making of Macbeth Sam Ervin Jazz Poll
conditionDescription: Pre-owned vintage issue. Cover shows toning with soiling and staining along the left edge and lower left area, plus corner wear at the upper left. Spine intact. No mailing label. Please review the photos for exact condition. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you.
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, February 1972 issue. Cover price one dollar.

Features:
- Behind the Making of "Macbeth" - Roman Polanski's film adaptation, which Playboy Productions financed and which had reached theaters only weeks earlier
- Robert Sherrill on Sam Ervin, profiled a year before Ervin chaired the Senate Watergate Committee
- 1972 Jazz & Pop Poll Results
- For the Two of You: Sensory Awakening

Profile cover with the Playboy rabbit signet ring.

The back cover carries a 1972 Winston "Down Home Taste" ad set in a country store.

Condition: pre-owned, complete issue with normal signs of age and storage.
